specification.name: trajectory_risk_and_preconformal_joint_action_selection_v2

old_results.usage: Old evaluation is retrospective diagnosis only; never fitting, tuning, early stopping or candidate selection.

proposal.action: complete three-axis proposal, after production gain bounds

scope.simulation: 10 second unit step, zero measurement noise
scope.safety: existing divergence/cost veto stops; no recovery
scope.return: best actually executed observation including initial

candidates.construction: Scale the complete Temp Only expected/shrunk log10 step; then apply original gain bounds.
candidates.selection: model_min_risk chooses lowest frozen temperature-scaled p(harmful), stable first index on ties, before any CP set.
candidates.duplicates: Keep candidate metadata; deduplicate exact post-bound gains for labels/simulation; first index represents ties.
candidates.unchanged: Selected unchanged candidate stops; it is not a reached changed calibration point.
candidates.cp_rejection: Stop. Do not retry another candidate after observing a CP set.

risk_features.new: 20 existing state descriptors +3 actually bounded steps +21 original choice probabilities; risk-only state[16]=0 at stage0, true previous cost change thereafter.
risk_features.old: Unmodified legacy 44 inputs, including initial state[16]=-J/5.
risk_features.proposal_inputs: Unchanged: feature correction is confined to the new risk head.

training.behavior: plant_index modulo 3 selects scale index for the entire trajectory; stop on unchanged behavior or safety.
training.labels: Measure all distinct changed joint candidates at each reached state. Only behavior action advances state; others diagnostic.
training.weighting: All collected candidate rows equally weighted; within-plant dependence is allowed in training, not IID calibration evidence.

temperature.method: NLL fit using independent complete trajectory cohort, same fixed behavior mixture

development_audit.usage: Fixed diagnostic cohort only; no hyperparameter, feature, temperature, action scale, threshold, budget or sample-size search.

risk_budget.harmful: J_after > J_before, zero tolerance; legacy >2% only secondary
risk_budget.coverage: Stagewise marginal selected-action label coverage under fresh reached-sample exchangeability conditional on frozen prefix; union bound over 20 stages. Not conditional-on-execution risk.

calibration.sampling: New independent plants for every arm/stage/batch; follow that arm frozen earlier thresholds. One selected changed candidate per reached plant at target stage.
calibration.quota: Take first 2000 reached in batch/plant generation order. Collection continuation depends only on reach count, never target score/label/q.
calibration.batch_excess: All actually measured excess candidates remain raw and charged; exclude only by predetermined order beyond quota.
calibration.initial512: Exactly 512 initial plants; actual reached n; rank>n -> q=1.
calibration.quota_shortfall: For reached2000, cap without quota -> q=1 even if rank<=n; explicitly engineering quota fallback, distinct from mathematical rank fallback.
calibration.unreachable: If any frozen earlier q>=1, every selected candidate at that stage holds: later stages structurally unreachable; record zero samples/full set without wasteful new simulations.

evaluation.paired: Same new plants across arms; no cross-arm calibration or evaluation fitting.
evaluation.monitor: Original full proposal and safety-stop behavior, no risk veto.
evaluation.rejected_diagnostics: Measure selected rejected action once for diagnosis, never feed state/history/best.
evaluation.selection: Primary arm fixed before data; other arms explanatory only; no winner selection using test.

acceptance.interpretation: Separate exact one-sided bounds, not joint 95%; mean/p90 are empirical gates.
acceptance.failure: research_only; preserve all results; no threshold/alpha/model/sample tweaks after test
acceptance.pass_scope: Only exact new research runner/scoped population; generic runtime defaults remain unchanged.

accounting.actual: Count every actual plant simulation once in initial/executed/diagnostic buckets; report cache hits and operating requests separately.
accounting.cache: Per-plant exact float64 gain tuple, deterministic simulator only; include every result-affecting setting via fixed protocol. No cross-plant reuse.
accounting.diagnostic: May enter operating history only if that exact action is later truly adopted; never update best merely from observing a rejected/alternative candidate.

specification.artifacts: Raw per-batch compressed shards with SHA256; training data and serialized model from scripts only; summaries/docs generated from JSON.
